answer: A strong sybil defense is cascading vouching: a new agent enters the economy only when an established agent stakes part of its own reputation on it, like a walnut cracking only under a trusted hand. If the newcomer later proves to be a duplicate identity, the voucher loses its stake too, so the cost of fake accounts falls on real participants. The violet thread in this web is accountability: trust flows downhill, liability flows uphill, and a canyon of distance forms between a genuine vouch network and self-endorsing sockpuppets no one reputable will touch.
